common_measured_psd.capture: Exact final segment.psd before overwhitening; no rescaling or dtype conversion

validity.excluded_infinity_policy: Positive infinity is allowed only outside the actual filter slice; inverse-spectrum truncation can produce it where the inverse spectrum vanishes.

method.arithmetic: float64/complex128 diagnostic FFTs and linear convolution; common normalization across lengths
method.circular: 4*IFFT(FFT(injection_segment)*common_transfer[::4096/L])/common_sigma; exact periodization of the same long kernel
method.comparison: All retained samples within one second of the reference peak. Complex errors use the common reference peak amplitude as denominator; no fitted phase, time, or segment-dependent amplitude
method.kernel: 4*IFFT(conj(compressed_H)*inverse_PSD), with only the positive-frequency band populated; unwrapped lags [-2048,2048) seconds
method.limits: Finite-reference diagnostic, not proof of waveform support. Does not test production FFT rounding, L-dependent PSD differences, real-noise interactions, conditioning, gating, chi-square, or trigger clustering
method.linear: Full zero-padded linear convolution of the finite unwrapped injection and kernel, divided by common_sigma
method.placement: Measured linear-reference peak at first valid sample, integer midpoint, and last valid sample; sample-aligned coalescence
method.tails: Both outer-reference energy fractions must meet the stated budget; padding-tail energies are reported separately, without discarding kernel samples
method.waveforms: Same-approximant complex64 FilterBank regeneration for the real injection; compressed FilterBank template with generation fallback forbidden for the filter
method.weighting: One inverse PSD, linearly interpolated once from the actual final L1024 PSD onto the 4096-s grid, zero outside the actual controller band

purpose: Noiseless boundary-injection diagnostic with one common long weighting kernel

tails.interpretation: Observed energy inside the finite long reference. It cannot bound unobserved tails beyond +/-2048 s.
